description_en: Obtains the metadata of a Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0-based service provider (SP)
description_zh: 获取基于SAML 2.0的服务提供商SP（Service Provider）的元数据
kebab_example: aliyun ecd get-sp-metadata --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --directory-id cn-hangzhou+dir-4006950000 --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-4006950000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSpMetadata
